scripts.dev: bash scripts/dev-env.sh prepare && python3 scripts/dev-supervisor.py --frontend-port 5173 --backend-port 8001 --frontend-command 'npm run dev --prefix frontend' --backend-command '.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001' --backend-cwd backend
scripts.dev:playwright: bash scripts/dev-env.sh prepare && python3 scripts/dev-supervisor.py --frontend-port 5273 --backend-port 8001 --frontend-command 'npm run dev:playwright --prefix frontend' --backend-command '.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001' --backend-cwd backend
scripts.devserver:ensure: bash scripts/dev-env.sh prepare && bash scripts/cursor-devserver.sh ensure
scripts.check: npm run check:worktree && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:worktree: bash scripts/test-worktree.sh && python3 scripts/test-worktree-env.py && python3 scripts/test-delegate-cursor-cli.py && python3 scripts/test-delegate-cursor-monitor.py && bash scripts/test-dev-env.sh && python3 scripts/test-dev-supervisor.py && python3 scripts/test-cursor-devserver.py
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . && uv run --directory backend python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix frontend && uv run --directory backend ruff format .
